name: Crafting Terraces Upper Level
description: The Upper Level of the Crafting Terraces is the elevated tier where master artisans refine weapons, armor, tools, and ceremonial items. Sandstone balconies, forge alcoves, workbenches, and clan-inscribed railings overlook the Artisan Ward below. Heat vents, arcane stabilizers, and supply lifts connect the terraces to lower workshops.
